releases.title: Public Release
highlights: Complete spatial logic puzzle game with 2,000 handcrafted levels
Dual gameplay modes: Classic rectangular partitioning + Weird Mode freeform polyominoes
3 crafted visual themes: Light Zen, Dark Zen, and Dark Neon
19 language localizations with dynamic font fallbacks
Pure 3-star mastery system: Grid Completed, Speed Master, Flawless Finish
Procedural PCM audio synthesis (zero audio files)
GPU MSDF vector typography for crisp rendering at any zoom
Mobile-optimized: Safe area adaptation, frustum culling, 6-tier zoom (1.0×-6.0×)
Fair monetization: Optional ad removal, thoughtful ad pacing
Built from scratch in Godot 4 engine
